## Sanitization & Quality Checklist
- [ ] **Zero Information Leakage**: No internal IPs, homelab hostnames, or credentials included.
- [ ] **Standardized Placeholders**: Used RFC 5737 (`192.0.2.x`), `example.com` (no subdomains), or generic path abstractions.
- [ ] **Link Integrity**: All relative links resolve to valid files.
- [ ] **Markdown / Schema Validity**: Fenced code blocks have language identifiers and JSON files are valid.
